subject: Badge scanning & lead capture: HubSpot sync + consent language
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: events@acme.com, support@leadcapture.co
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Badge scanning & lead capture: HubSpot sync + consent language

Hi team,

We need to lock the lead capture flow for ACME's booth at Summit West (Aug 12-14). Key asks:

- Confirm badge scanner vendor can push leads to our HubSpot instance in near-real time (including source/event).
- Agree final consent language for EU/US attendees (GDPR/CAN-SPAM safe).
- Produce a field map that maps scanner fields to HubSpot contact properties and the ACME opportunity metadata.
- Note any network/Wi-Fi or device prep required on-site.

Attached: a draft consent language (consent-language-v1.docx) and a proposed HubSpot field mapping (hubspot-field-map.xlsx).

Connor — can you review the attached mapping and flag any required property renames or validation rules? Also need an estimate for test sync to our staging HubSpot instance.

Monica — can you confirm whether ACME needs any custom opt-in checkboxes or multi-language copy? If they do, we'll push updates to the consent doc and run legal review.

I'll also loop LeadCapture for device-level config and data retention settings. Goal: everything tested by Aug 1.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0193

Attachments: consent-language-v1.docx, hubspot-field-map.xlsx

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, support@leadcapture.co
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Badge scanning & lead capture: HubSpot sync + consent language

Thanks Marissa — jumping in with initial notes.

Quick answers:
- HubSpot sync: this is doable, LeadCapture needs to POST to our HubSpot form endpoint or use the HubSpot API key connector. I prefer the API approach for deduping and enrichment.
- Field map (checked hubspot-field-map.xlsx): we should rename "Company (raw)" -> "company_raw" and add a dedupe key = email or badge_id. Also recommend adding "event_source" = "ACME_SummitWest_2025" as a hidden mapped property.
- Staging: I can stand up a test API key and sample form in staging. Estimate: 2 days for mapping + 1 day test run.

Questions for LeadCapture:
1) Do you capture explicit timestamp + device_id per scan? We need that for audit.
2) How do you handle attendees who opt out at the kiosk — do you suppress PII from the sync?

Marissa — I can take ownership of the staging test once LeadCapture confirms endpoints. I'll also schedule a 30-min test window.

Connor
Sr. Sales Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

From: LeadCapture Co <support@leadcapture.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Events Team <events@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 15:22:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Badge scanning & lead capture: HubSpot sync + consent language

Hi Marissa / Connor,

Thanks for the details. Quick answers to Connor's questions and what we'll need to configure:

- Data captured per scan: attendee_name, email (if collected), badge_id, timestamp (ISO8601), device_id, scan_location, custom_fields (e.g., interest_tags). We attach a CSV stub of the column export: badge-scanner-config.csv.
- Opt-out handling: scanners can be configured with an explicit "Do not share my data" toggle. If toggled, the device omits email and hashes badge_id before any sync; we can also flag those records with property "consent=false" so your sync rule can drop PII.
- HubSpot integration: we support two modes — direct API push to Contacts + custom property mapping, or a queued webhook to an intermediate staging endpoint. For dedupe we recommend using email if available, otherwise badge_id + event_source.
- Network: devices support LTE SIM (preferred) or local Wi‑Fi (802.11ac). For guaranteed throughput at the show floor, LTE is recommended.

Action items for Marissa/Connor:
- Provide final consent text for display at kiosks.
- Confirm preferred integration mode (API direct vs queued webhook).
- Provide staging HubSpot API key or form endpoint.

We've attached the device config sample (badge-scanner-config.csv) and a short integration guide link: https://leadcapture.co/docs/hubspot-sync.

Best,
Samira Khan
Customer Success | LeadCapture Co
support@leadcapture.co

Attachments: badge-scanner-config.csv

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Badge scanning & lead capture: HubSpot sync + consent language

Thanks — quick legal/reg ask from my side after reading the draft consent: we should make the kiosk copy shorter and explicit about downstream use. Suggested front-line copy (one line + hover for details):

"By scanning your badge you agree to receive follow-up from Redwood Inference and event partners about product updates and offers. You may unsubscribe at any time.

Full details: [link]"

Notes: 
- Replace "unsubscribe" with "opt-out" only where legal requires.
- For EU attendees we need the explicit checkbox/affirmative opt-in — do not use pre-checked boxes.

Connor — if HubSpot will receive a consent property, call it "event_consent_opt_in" (boolean). That will make reporting clean.

If everyone is comfortable, I'll update consent-language-v1.docx and attach a short, on-screen copy + a link-to-privacy doc.

Monica
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, support@leadcapture.co
Date: Sat, 5 Jul 2025 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Badge scanning & lead capture: HubSpot sync + consent language

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, all. Final decisions and owners: 

- Consent language: Monica to finalize short on-screen copy and the detailed privacy link. Deadline: Jul 8. (Attachment will be consent-language-final.docx).
- Integration mode: LeadCapture will use direct HubSpot API push; Connor to provide staging API key by Jul 9.
- Field mapping: Connor will update hubspot-field-map.xlsx with property rename (company_raw) and add "event_source" + "event_consent_opt_in" properties.
- Test window: Jul 15 09:00-10:00 PT — Connor will schedule and invite testers.
- Hardware/network: LeadCapture recommends LTE; ACME to confirm on-site power and location.

Samira (LeadCapture) — thanks for the config CSV. Once Monica sends final consent wording, please confirm the kiosk display character limit (max 200 chars) and confirm that toggling "Do not share" suppresses PII in the sync.

I'll mark this thread as the official runbook for Summit West lead ops. If all good, I'll upload final attachments and the Drive folder link to the event asset.

Thanks,
Marissa
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
